raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This is a stacked bar chart showing the data for different countries from 2013 to 2022. The chart type is a grouped bar chart, with the x-axis representing the years from 2013 to 2022 and the y-axis representing values in thousands of hectares. The y-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 1200, with a linear scale. The x-axis lists the years in chronological order. Each country is represented by a different color: Spain (blue), France (orange), China/Continental (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light blue), USA (green), and Argentina (dark blue). The chart displays the values for each country in each year, with the bars stacked to show the total value. The legend on the right side of the chart indicates the color for each country. The chart provides a visual representation of the data for each country over the 10-year period, allowing for easy comparison of the values across different years and countries. The values for Spain are consistently the highest, while the values for Argentina are consistently the lowest. The values for the other countries fall in between, with some fluctuations over the years.
